Context: 12. Removal l Dismissal

Removal / Dismissal from servi.ce of a Government servant are the major penalties which can be imposed upon a Government servant by the Competent Authority for good and sufficient reasons, after· observing the procedure prescribed in the Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1965. The penalty 'removal from service" is not a. disqualification for future employment under the Governrrrent whereas 'dismissal from service' shall ordinarily be a disqualification for such employment.
